desc:
From the creators of Super Hero Tycoon 🦸‍♂️, we present you Hero Brawl! Here, you can become one of your favorite superheroes ⭐ and fight ⚔️ on the battleground 🌆 with unique powers ⚡ !

Select your superhero from the multiverse 🌌 of Marvel and DC: Captain America, Deadpool, Wolverine, Ant-Man, Black Panther, Iron Man, Batman, Spider-Man, Thor, Green Lantern, Hulk, Superman, The Flash 😎. Dominate the battlegrounds 🏆 with powers from fireballs 🔥 and lasers, to guns and katanas 🗡️!

Don't forget to leave some Feedback 📝 and Thumbs Up the Game 👍 to show your support!

📌 NOTE: WE ARE STILL IN BETA TESTING, THE GAME IS FAR FROM DONE! THANK YOU FOR YOUR SUPPORT!
